acanthocobitis-botia.name: Zipper loach
notes: Item 1: "Dulu ikan ini lama dianggap" is awkward; use "Ikan ini lama dianggap" or "Dulu dianggap".
Item 5: "beech, oak" are left in English; use "daun kering beech (Fagus), ek" or similar.
Item 5: "aufwuchs" is left untranslated with no gloss; add "(lapisan alga dan mikroorganisme)".
Item 5: "setup" is used repeatedly; "tata letak akuarium" or "aquascape" is more natural.

acanthocobitis-zonalternans.name: Zipper Loach
notes: Item 2: the neotype locality quote is left in English ('4 kilometers south of Amphoe Mae Ramat on road 1085 ... Tak Province, Salween basin, Thailand'). Translate the descriptive words, e.g. '4 kilometer di selatan Amphoe Mae Ramat di jalan 1085 ... Provinsi Tak, cekungan Salween, Thailand'. Keep the place names.
Item 5: 'daun kering beech, oak' leaves the English names in place. Use 'daun beech (Fagus) dan ek' or add a short gloss.
Item 5: 'setup' and 'hill stream' stay in English. 'Setup' is common, but 'tata letak/penataan akuarium' and 'akuarium tipe sungai pegunungan berarus' read more naturally.
Item 5: 'aufwuchs' is left untranslated. Add a gloss such as 'aufwuchs (lapisan alga dan biofilm)'.

acanthopsoides-molobrion.name: Dwarf Horse-faced Loach
notes: Item 11: "seorang hobiis, Mark Duffill" names a forum member and drops the "SF member" attribution; consider a neutral "seorang hobiis" without the name.
Item 12: "Lokasi tipe" and "duri sub-okular" are stiff; "lokalitas tipe" and "duri di bawah mata" read more naturally.
Item 12: "Ikan hias" is fine, but "tuberkel kawin" and "kromatofor" could use a short gloss for hobbyist readers.

acanthopsoides-robertsi.name: Dwarf Horseface Loach
notes: "5,2 sampai 7,2 dalam panjang kepala" and "2 sampai 2,5 dalam panjang kepala" read awkwardly. Rephrase as "5,2–7,2 kali dalam panjang kepala" or "panjang kepala 5,2–7,2 kali diameter mata".
"batu yang halus terkikis air" is clumsy. Use "batu yang halus karena terkikis air" or "batu sungai yang halus".
"bintil-bintil kawin kecil (breeding tubercle)": "bintil pemijahan" is more usual; the bracketed English is fine.
"danau tapal kuda" for oxbow is acceptable but could be "danau tapal kuda (oxbow)" or "kolam bekas meander sungai" for clarity.

acantopsis-dialuzona.name: Horseface loach
notes: Item 12: "sirip ekor yang sedikit bercabang" and "sirip ekor bercabang atau berlekuk dalam" translate "forked" with "bercabang". That also means "branched" (as in branched rays), so it is ambiguous. Use "bercagak" or "berpangkal dua" instead.
Item 3: "sebagian besar (kalaupun ada)" renders "a significant percentage (if any)" as "most", which is stronger than the source. Use "persentase yang signifikan (kalaupun ada)".
Item 3: "dari setiap kajian yang mendetail" is a bit loose. Use "dari kajian yang mendetail".
Item 6: "batu yang tergerus air" is awkward for "water-worn rocks". Use "batu sungai yang halus terkikis air" or "batu kali".

acrochordonichthys-gyrinus.name: Falcate Chameleon Catfish
notes: "teman setangki" (items 1, 8) is slightly unnatural. "ikan penghuni akuarium yang sama" or "tankmate" would be more usual for Indonesian hobbyists.
"tanpa lipatan daging" (item 9) is a bit literal for "fleshy flap". "tanpa lipatan berdaging" reads more naturally.

acrochordonichthys-rugosus.name: Asian Banjo Catfish
notes: Item 2/16: "Risiko Rendah (Least Concern)" is a slightly non-standard rendering of the IUCN category. "Berisiko Rendah" or "Risiko Rendah" with the English term is acceptable, but keep it consistent with the Indonesian IUCN usage.
Item 7: "kimia air yang naik-turun" is a bit stiff. Consider "parameter air yang berfluktuasi".
Item 8: "Kayu dan akar yang sudah lama terendam" for "Aged driftwood" slightly shifts the meaning. Consider "kayu apung yang sudah matang/tua (driftwood)".
Item 12: "Meskipun sebenarnya tidak suka bergerombol" is a bit stronger than "not really gregarious". Consider "kurang bersifat bergerombol".

acrochordonichthys-septentrionalis.name: Mae Klong Chameleon Catfish
notes: "stres dalam bentuk tertentu" is stiff and slightly unclear for "stressed in some way". Use "mengalami stres/tertekan oleh sebab tertentu".
"batu dan kerikil sungai yang halus terkikis air" is awkward for "water-worn rocks and pebbles". Use "batu dan kerikil sungai yang bulat/halus terkikis air", or simply "batu dan kerikil sungai".
"pori aksila" is very technical. Consider adding the English term in brackets, "pori aksila (axillary pore)".
"pengaturan seperti ini membantu" is a loose rendering of "such an arrangement provides assistance". Use "pengelompokan seperti ini membantu".
"Seperti kerabatnya satu genus" is clumsy. Use "Seperti spesies lain dalam genusnya".

agamyxis-pectinifrons.name: Raphael tutul
notes: Item 1: 'Max size: 150 mm SL (6 in)' became '15 cm SL' – fine, but item 3 'Polygonium sp.' etc unchanged; no issue. Real issue in item 4: volume stated as 'sekitar 108 liter' with no tank height given; acceptable. Main issue: item 2 'Region Loreto' should be 'Wilayah/Departemen Loreto' (Region is untranslated English).
Item 2: 'Batas pasti sebaran alaminya masih agak belum jelas' is awkward; use 'masih kurang jelas'.
Item 2: 'Lokasi tipe' should be 'lokalitas tipe' (standard taxonomic term); 'Equador' in the quote is fine.

Item 3: 'mengalir 'sedimen terlarut membuat air keruh' – source says 'reducing visibility'; fine, but 'polong-polongan' for 'leguminous species' is okay. 'padang apung' is a coined term; keep English in brackets only once consistently.

Item 7: 'omnivora generalis' is stiff; use 'omnivora dan tidak pemilih (generalis)'. 'Tubifex' translated as 'cacing sutra' is OK but 'pakan buatan' for 'prepared foods' should be 'pakan olahan/pabrikan'.
Item 11: 'sisik keras (scute)' – scutes are bony plates, not scales; use 'lempeng tulang (scute)'. 'klad' is unusual; use 'kelompok monofiletik (clade)'.
Item 11: 'memperkeras suara' mistranslates 'projection of the noise'; should be 'memancarkan/menyalurkan suara'.
Item 11: 'kerabat segenusnya' – 'congener' fine; but 'Region'/'lele driftwood' fine. 'konon' for 'ostensibly' adds hearsay nuance; use 'tampaknya/dengan alasan'.

akysis-ephippifer.name: Akysis ephippifer
notes: "mudah dipelihara oleh penghobi yang cukup berpengalaman": "any decent fishkeeper" means almost any reasonably competent keeper; consider "penghobi yang kompeten/pada umumnya" so it doesn't imply experience is required.
"dalam 30 cm": for tank depth, use "panjang/lebar depan-belakang" or "kedalaman" more naturally, e.g. "30 cm (lebar) x 20 cm (tinggi) x 30 cm (dalam)" could be clearer.
"gua": hobbyists usually say "gua-gua kecil" or "shelter/tempat sembunyi"; the plural "caves" is not reflected.
"sirip ekor yang sedikit berlekuk (emarginate)": "emarginate" means a shallow notch; "sedikit" is acceptable, but "berlekuk dangkal" is more precise.
"Data Deficient (Kekurangan Data)": the standard Indonesian IUCN term is "Data Kurang"; use "Data Kurang (Data Deficient)".
"kutu air" for daphnia: hobbyists often use "kutu air" for Daphnia, though "Daphnia" is also common; this is fine but could add "(daphnia)".

akysis-hendricksoni.name: Hendrickson's Stream Catfish
notes: Item 19: "Wakil Rektor" for "Vice-Chancellor" is a questionable equivalent (a vice-chancellor is closer to a rector or head). Use "Rektor" or "Wakil Kanselir", or keep the English title.
Item 14: "hillstream loach dari famili Balitoridae" adds "hillstream", which is not in the source. Use "lohok/loach balitorid" or "famili Balitoridae" only.
Item 5: "sungai kecil yang cukup besar (lebar sekitar 10 m)" is contradictory and awkward. Use "anak sungai yang cukup lebar (sekitar 10 m)" or just "sungai".
Item 9: "penghobi yang cukup berpengalaman" reads more demanding than "any decent fishkeeper". Use "penghobi yang kompeten" or "penghobi pada umumnya".
Item 8: "moss" is left in English. Use "lumut (moss)" or "berbagai jenis lumut air".
Item 19: "kysis = kantong" for "bladder" is imprecise. "Kandung" or "kantung" would be better, since the reference is to the swim bladder.
Item 12: "jentik kaca (glassworm)" is a loose rendering of the glassworm (Chaoborus larva). Hobbyists usually say "cacing kaca" or "jentik lonceng/kaca", so check the term.

akysis-heterurus.name: Lele Akysis
notes: Item 4: "depan-belakang 30 cm" is awkward for tank depth; use "dalam 30 cm" or "lebar 30 cm x tinggi 20 cm x dalam 30 cm".
Item 4: "gua-gua kecil sebagai tempat bersembunyi" adds "kecil" and "sebagai tempat bersembunyi", which the source does not say; use "gua" only.
Item 3: the gloss after "unculiferous" ("yaitu tonjolan kecil yang permukaannya dipenuhi tonjolan halus seperti kait") is not in the source; remove it or shorten it to "berunculi".

akysis-maculipinnis.name: Spotfin Stream Catfish
notes: Item 14: "alur-alur melingkar di sekitar lubangnya" for "radial grooves" is wrong, because melingkar means circular. Use "alur-alur yang memancar dari lubangnya" or similar.
Item 8: "moss", "beech" and "oak" are left in English. Use "lumut" or "moss" with a gloss, and "daun beech/ek" with a gloss.
Item 15: "air yang sudah diendapkan" for "aged water" is slightly off. "air yang sudah didiamkan/diendapkan (aged)" is more natural, and "diffuser" could get a local gloss.
Item 13: "wajib cari tahu dulu dengan benar" is colloquial for a handbook. Use "wajib dipelajari dulu dengan cermat".

akysis-pulvinatus.name: Kra stream catfish
notes: "betina yang sedang bertelur" for "gravid female": gravid means carrying eggs, not yet spawning. Use "betina yang sedang bunting telur" or "penuh telur".
"alur-alur melingkar di sekitar lubangnya" for "radial grooves at the pore": radial means grooves radiating outward. Use "alur-alur yang memancar dari lubang".
"batu-batu sungai yang halus" for "water-worn rocks": better as "batu sungai yang halus/membulat karena terkikis air".
Item 8: "hillstream loach (balitorid)" is fine, but "tumbuh terlalu besar" would read more naturally as "terlalu besar saat dewasa".

akysis-varius.name: Akysis varius
notes: Item 16: "Pola warna dewasa sudah terbentuk sempurna baru 23 hari kemudian" reverses the nuance. The English "after just 23 days" means it was fast, but "baru" reads as late. Use "hanya dalam 23 hari" or "sudah terbentuk sempurna hanya setelah 23 hari".
Items 1, 17, 18: "sirip ekor tegak (truncate)" is a questionable rendering. "Tegak" does not describe a caudal fin shape. Use "sirip ekor terpotong rata (truncate)".
Item 1: "Variable stream catfish" is left in English in the running text. Add a local gloss such as "lele sungai variabel" or keep it clearly marked as a trade name.
Item 17: "alat bisa (venom)" is awkward. "Kelenjar bisa" or "struktur penyuntik bisa" is more natural.

akysis-vespa.name: Wasp Catfish
notes: #8: "(misalnya lumut Java)" is not in the source. Delete it or keep only "berbagai jenis lumut".
#14: "hillstream loach dari famili Balitoridae" adds "hillstream", which the source doesn't have. Use "lonjong/loach balitorid" or "loach Balitoridae" without the addition.
#14: "Lele akysid lain ... direkomendasikan untuk lapisan bawah akuarium" is slightly awkward. "Ikan lele akysid" would be more natural.

allenbatrachus-grunniens.name: Ikan kodok
notes: Item 2: "menggerutu/mendengkur" for Latin 'grunting' is imprecise. Use "mendengus" or "menggeram" (grunting sound), and give one term rather than two.
Item 1: the opening "Freshwater toadfish" is left in English. Give an Indonesian name or gloss first, e.g. "Ikan kodok air tawar (freshwater toadfish)".
Item 5: "Spesies ini cukup umum di dunia akuarium" is slightly vague. "Dalam dunia akuarium hobi" or "di kalangan hobiis" would sound more natural.

ambastaia-nigrolineata.name: Black-lined Loach
notes: Item 9: 'karena Ambastaia spp. ikan yang penuh rasa ingin tahu' lacks the copula; write 'merupakan ikan yang penuh rasa ingin tahu'.
Item 7: 'riam' for 'riffles' suggests rapids or waterfalls; 'bagian berarus deras dan dangkal' or 'riak' is closer.
Item 12: 'ikan lele' for 'catfishes' usually means Clarias; 'berbagai jenis catfish' or 'ikan berkumis' is better for ornamental catfish.

ambastaia-sidthimunki.name: Botia sidthimunki
notes: Item 6: "karena Ambastaia spp. ikan yang penasaran" is missing a verb. Write "karena Ambastaia spp. adalah ikan yang penasaran".
Item 11: "indukan dewasanya" adds the idea of breeders. The source says only "adult specimens", so use "ikan dewasanya".
Item 11: the report link ("available here") is turned into "Mark juga menulis laporan lengkap". The reader can no longer find the report, so keep a pointer to it.
Item 3: the acknowledgement "Thanks to Kamphol Udomritthiruj" is dropped. Restore it, or make sure the source credit is kept in the "K. Udomritthiruj, komunikasi pribadi" citation.
Item 12: "Pertunjukan seperti ini" for "Such displays" reads oddly. Use "Tampilan seperti ini" or "Perilaku semacam ini".
Item 6: "batu dan kerikil yang halus bekas tergerus air" is clumsy. Use "batu dan kerikil halus yang terkikis air".

amblypharyngodon-chulabhornae.name: Princess Carplet
notes: Item 5: "siklus nitrogennya belum matang" is fine, but "Paling cocok dipelihara" is a slight shift from "Best maintained"; acceptable. Main issue: "ikan ikutan (bycatch)" is unnatural; use "ikan tangkapan sampingan" or "ikan campuran yang ikut terbawa".
Item 1/3: "Princess carplet" left untranslated with no local name; consider adding a descriptive Indonesian rendering or keeping it in italics/quotes as a trade name.
Item 2: "Lokasi tipe" is fine, but the type locality text is left in English ("Province"); consider "Provinsi" or keep as a quoted citation consistently.
Item 4: "Panjang standar: 4 cm" drops the precision of 40 mm; write "40 mm (4 cm)" or "4,0 cm".
Item 5: "Filter tidak perlu terlalu kuat karena ikan ini kebanyakan berasal dari..." is slightly awkward; use "karena ikan ini umumnya berasal dari perairan yang tenang".
Item 8: "tidak mudah stres" replaces "less nervous" (more skittish); prefer "tidak mudah gugup/penakut".
Item 7: "kutu air" for Daphnia is acceptable but the common hobby term is "kutu air (Daphnia)"; consider keeping "Daphnia" explicitly.

amphilophus-labiatus.name: Red Devil
notes: Item 11: "belang" (barred) and "belang-belang tidak beraturan (piebald)" are too close to tell apart. Use "bergaris/berpita vertikal" for barred.
Item 5: "saat sedang heboh" is informal. Use something like "saat sedang sangat aktif/agresif".
Item 3: "limbah kotoran mentah" is awkward. Use "limbah tinja/kotoran mentah" or "limbah kotoran yang belum diolah".

anabas-testudineus.name: Ikan Betok
notes: Item 9: "mastacembelid (sidat/belut berduri)": sidat is Anguilla, a different fish. Use "tilan" or "belut duri".
Item 12: "peternakan komersial" for commercial farms: peternakan means livestock. Use "usaha budidaya ikan komersial" or "pembudidaya".
Item 12: "data deficient" is left in English quotes with a gloss. This is acceptable, but "data kurang (data deficient)" would read more naturally.

apteronotus-albifrons.name: Black Ghost
notes: Item 8: "makin kurus dan akhirnya mati" adds a death outcome. The source says only "wastes away". Use "makin kurus" or "menyusut kondisinya".
Items 1 and 2: "separuh bagian utara" for "upper half" is acceptable, but "bagian utara" alone may be more natural. Paraguay is in the south, so the phrase is slightly inaccurate in the source too.

apteronotus-leptorhynchus.name: Brown Ghost Knifefish
notes: "rutin diimpor" for "regularly stocked": slightly shifts meaning (stocked = available in shops). Consider "rutin tersedia" or "rutin dijual".
"Apteronotus leptorhynchus berwarna keemasan" with no article or noun: reads awkwardly. Consider "seekor Apteronotus leptorhynchus ..." or add "ikan".

astronotus-ocellatus.name: Ikan Oscar
notes: Item 1: 'Ukuran maksimal: 35 cm SL' / 'mencapai 35 cm SL' – 350 mm = 35 cm is correct, no issue; but see other items.
Item 12: 'cacing sutra' for tubifex is acceptable, but 'karnivora sejati' for 'serious carnivores' is fine; main issue: 'Oscar sangat menuntut kualitas kimia air' is okay.
Item 14: 'pastikan tetap memilih jenis-jenis dari Amerika Selatan juga' is slightly awkward; better 'pilih hanya jenis dari Amerika Selatan'.
Item 17: 'enam ekor anakan atau lebih' – 'half-a-dozen or more' fine; 'burayak' for fry is acceptable but 'benih' is more common among hobbyists.

Item 18: 'dibuahi oleh jantan dengan berenang di atasnya' – original says male swims over to fertilize; acceptable. 'Oscar bisa pilih-pilih dalam memilih pasangan' is repetitive; use 'sangat selektif dalam memilih pasangan'.
Item 19: 'bersifat kamuflase' for 'cryptic' colour pattern is fine but inconsistent with 'kriptik' used elsewhere; 'tribus dugaan' is awkward, use 'tribus yang diduga (putative)'.
Item 2: 'Area berenang: Atas dan tengah' ok; the source 'Minimum tank size 65 gallons (about 250 litres)' conversion: 65 US gal ≈ 246 L, OK.
Item 18: '100 gallon (about 380 litres)' fine.
Item 12: 'cacing darah' for bloodworms fine; but 'Meskipun sebagian orang menyarankan... pakan hidup' fine. Item 3: 'Populasi liar hasil introduksi' fine.
Item 6: Omitted the US gallon conversion — fine per instructions.

astyanax-mexicanus.name: Blind Cave Tetra
notes: Item 10: "pada sore atau malam hari" adds "sore"; the source says only "in the evening" ("pada malam hari").
Item 10: "Biasanya mereka sudah memijah" adds "Biasanya" (usually), which softens the source's "They should have spawned". Use "Mereka seharusnya sudah memijah".
Items 5 and 10: "setup" is left as English. "Penataan akuarium" or "set-up" would be more natural.

atractosteus-spatula.name: Ikan aligator
notes: #2: "hingga ke selatan sampai negara bagian Veracruz" is redundant. Use "hingga ke selatan sampai negara bagian Veracruz" -> "hingga ke negara bagian Veracruz di selatan".

#8: "ikan yang tidak agresif dengan ukuran serupa yang tidak muat di mulutnya" is ambiguous because of the stacked "yang". Rephrase, e.g. "ikan non-agresif berukuran serupa yang terlalu besar untuk muat di mulutnya".

bagrichthys-hypselopterus.name: Black Lancer
notes: Item 1: "Risiko Rendah" is the old IUCN term; use the standard "Berisiko Rendah" or "Risiko Rendah (Least Concern)" / "Kurang Perhatian" as commonly used in Indonesia.
Item 1: "Lokasi tipe" is acceptable but "Lokalitas tipe" is the more standard taxonomic term.
Item 2: "baung (lele bagrid)" is imprecise; bagrid catfish are usually called "baung" or "lele bagrid" but not both as equivalents. Pick one, e.g. "lele bagrid (baung)".
Item 2: "istmus" should be "isthmus" or "ismus"; the explanation in brackets is fine.
Item 7: "pemijahan" is fine, but "Belum dilaporkan" combined with "Tidak ada laporan" is redundant; this mirrors the source, so keep it short if needed.

bagrichthys-obscurus.name: Black Lancer
notes: Item 1: "gigi mulut yang sangat tereduksi" is stiff; use "gigi pada rongga mulut sangat mengecil/berkurang".
Item 1: "sungut mandibula ... bergerigi halus (berlekuk)" is awkward; crenulated is better as "bergerigi halus/bergelombang", and "sungut rahang bawah bagian dalam dan luar" is more natural.
Item 1: "batang ekor (pangkal ekor)" is redundant; keep "pangkal ekor" (caudal peduncle).
Item 5: "Pemanas (heater)" and then "luka bakar akibat heater" is inconsistent; use "pemanas" both times.

Item 5: "tempat persembunyian tersebut tidak tersedia dan tidak mudah dijangkau" slightly shifts the meaning of "if one is not provided and easily accessed"; rephrase as "jika tidak tersedia atau sulit dijangkau".
Item 6: "Mau menerima pakan buatan dengan mudah" is awkward; use "Mudah menerima pakan olahan/pakan buatan".
Item 4: the source gives 22.0-28.0°C; the translation "22–28 °C" is fine, but keep a consistent decimal format if precision matters.

bangana-behri.name: Incisilabeo
notes: "Nama umum: Two-headed carp" left in English; consider adding an Indonesian rendering such as "ikan karper berkepala dua" or keep the trade name with a gloss.
"ikan karper" for carp is fine, but "aneh" for "bizarre" could be more natural as "unik/tidak lazim".
"Asal nama" for "Lexicon" is acceptable, but "Etimologi" is the more standard term in a handbook.
"fasilitas importir" for "importer's fishhouse" is slightly vague; "gudang/tempat penampungan ikan importir" is more natural.
"Benggala" for Bengal is dated; "Bengal" or "Benggala" with context is acceptable but check consistency.
"daerah aliran Sungai Mekong" for "Mekong basin" is a bit stiff; "Daerah Aliran Sungai (DAS) Mekong" is the standard form.
"makan terutama alga" is slightly clipped; "terutama memakan alga" reads more naturally.

barbodes-semifasciolatus.name: Golden barb
notes: Item 12: "late in the day" is rendered "menjelang sore"; "sore hari" or "menjelang malam" is closer to the source.
Item 1: "sama sekali tidak agresif" is a small addition. "Absolutely peaceful" could simply be "sangat damai" or "benar-benar damai".

barbonymus-altus.name: Red Tail Tinfoil Barb
notes: Item 4: '(8 in)' and '(60 × 24 in)' and '(~143 US gal)' dropped. Metric conversion is fine, but 'Standard length: 210 mm SL (8 in)' is already metric, so this is acceptable; no real issue except 'SL' left without explanation.

Item 5: 'koloni bakteri yang diinginkan' misattaches 'desired' (levels of oxygen, flow and surface area are what is desired); rephrase to 'tingkat oksigen, arus, dan luas permukaan yang diinginkan untuk koloni bakteri'.
Item 5: 'mudah kaget' for 'skittish' is fine, but 'kadang cukup' is vague; minor.
Item 7: 'zukini yang sudah direbus sebentar' fine; 'kutu air' for Daphnia is acceptable but 'Daphnia' is the usual hobby term, so keep Daphnia/kutu air.
Item 8: 'Hasilnya, tampilan akuarium akan jauh lebih alami, plus perilaku ...' is awkward; 'plus' is colloquial. Rephrase to 'serta perilaku ikan yang menarik'.
Item 8: 'mudah kaget atau bahkan agresif' for 'skittish' acceptable; 'cara makannya yang cukup beringas' is a bit strong for 'rather vigorous feeding behaviour'; use 'cukup agresif/bersemangat'.
Item 10: 'menghasilkan anakan dalam jumlah besar' – 'broods' fine; 'penyebar telur' acceptable but 'egg-scatterer' is usually 'penyebar telur (egg scatterer)'.
Item 11: 'Banyak pemilik toko akan bilang' is colloquial; use 'akan mengatakan'.
Item 11: 'sirip perut' for pelvic fins is fine; no change.
Item 2/3: 'Pada bulan-bulan yang lebih basah ini' is slightly awkward; use 'pada bulan-bulan basah tersebut'.

barbronia-weberi.name: Lintah Asia
notes: "Alat isap" for suckers: the standard zoological term is "batil isap" (anterior/posterior).
"udang hias kerdil" for dwarf shrimp is stilted. Use "dwarf shrimp" or "udang hias"/"udang kerdil".

belontia-hasselti.name: Selincah
notes: Item 10: "sangat subur" for "very fecund" is imprecise. Use something like "menghasilkan banyak telur".
Item 10: "dengan jantan yang menjaga telur" narrows "paternal" to egg guarding. Use "jantan yang mengasuh telur dan anakan" or "pengasuhan oleh jantan".
Item 3: "kerabat murad" for Melaleuca (myrtle) is vague. Consider "Melaleuca (famili Myrtaceae/gelam)".
Item 5: "Buah alder (alder cone)" is awkward. Consider "kerucut alder" or "kerucut pohon alder".

betta-albimarginata.name: Betta albimarginata
notes: "Genting (Endangered)": hobbyists and Indonesian IUCN usage more commonly say "Terancam Punah"; consider that term (in items 1 and 11).
"memancing warna": slightly awkward; "memunculkan warna" or "mempercantik warna" is more natural.

betta-anabatoides.name: Betta anabatoides
notes: Item 6: "bisa mencapai panjang sekitar 12,5 cm" turns "up to 5 inches" into an approximation; "hingga 12,5 cm" or "mencapai 12,5 cm" is closer.
Item 2: "cukup toleran" softens "more tolerant"; "lebih toleran" would be more literal.

betta-balunga.name: Betta balunga
notes: Item 3: "Dipelihara di air lunak dengan TDS rendah, tetapi ikan ini cukup toleran" – the source is slightly illogical; the translation is fine, but consider "Biasanya dipelihara di air lunak..." for natural flow.
Item 2: "Satu lagi jenis cupang pengeram mulut" – "cupang mouthbrooder" is the more common hobby term; "pengeram mulut" is acceptable but less common.

Item 5: the source repeats itself ("groups, in a pair or a group"); the translation merges them, which is fine, but "sangat damai" could be made more explicit as "tampaknya sangat damai" – already present, no change needed beyond style.
Item 4: "Diberi pakan blackworm (cacing hitam) hidup" – hobbyists usually say "cacing sutra/blackworm"; "cacing hitam" is a non-standard gloss, so consider keeping just "blackworm".

betta-burdigala.name: Betta burdigala
notes: Item 1: "termasuk kelompok Betta coccina" – "complex" is usually rendered "kompleks" / "kelompok (complex)"; acceptable but could use "kompleks Betta coccina".
Item 3: "Max size: 1.2 - 1.5 inches" converts to about 3–3,8 cm, which is correct; "1 pasang untuk setiap 19 liter" is correct (5 gal ≈ 19 L).
Item 7: "Pembuat sarang busa" – the usual hobby term is "bubble nester" ("pembuat sarang gelembung"); use "Bubble nester (pembuat sarang gelembung)" instead of "busa" (foam).

betta-channoides.name: Betta channoides
notes: Item 3: "untuk setiap sekitar 19 liter air" is awkward; use "sepasang untuk setiap ±19 liter air" or "per 19 liter air".
Item 5: "blackworms" translated as "cacing sutra" (tubifex/silk worms) is a different worm; use "cacing hitam (blackworm)" instead.
Item 4: "suhu yang lebih tinggi memicu munculnya warna" is slightly awkward; use "memunculkan warna yang lebih cerah" or "memperkuat warna".
Item 4: "tahan air ber-TDS tinggi" is awkward; use "toleran terhadap air dengan TDS tinggi".

Item 5: "Currently fed" is rendered passively; "Saat ini diberi pakan hidup" is acceptable, but "Cacing darah beku dan pelet juga diberikan" reads stiffly; use "Juga bisa diberi cacing darah beku dan pelet".

betta-dimidiata.name: Betta dimidiata
notes: Item 4: "Sungai-sungai kecil dan genangan hutan berair hitam (blackwater) yang lunak dan asam" is slightly ambiguous; rephrase as "sungai kecil dan genangan di hutan dengan air blackwater yang lunak dan asam".
Item 6: "susunan kayu apung (driftwood) yang rapat" – driftwood is usually "kayu" or "akar kayu"; "kayu apung" literally means floating wood. Use "susunan kayu driftwood yang rapat" or "kayu rendam".
Item 8: "Teman satu akuarium" is awkward; use "penghuni lain" or "ikan penghuni bersama".
Item 10: "pengeram mulut (mouthbrooder) di mana jantan yang mengerami telur" is clumsy; use "pengeram mulut paternal (jantan yang mengerami telur di mulut)".
Item 10: "burayak" is correct but "baby artemia" mixes English and local terms; use "nauplii artemia" or "artemia baru menetas".
Item 9: "warnanya lebih kusam" for "more muted" is slightly negative; use "warnanya lebih kalem" or "tidak semencolok".

betta-edithae.name: Cupang Edithae
notes: Item 2: "habitat" became "akuarium untuk ikan ini". This narrows the meaning a little. "habitat (akuarium/tangki)" or "tempat pemeliharaan" would be closer.

betta-hendra.name: Betta hendra
notes: "botanical" is left in English; use "botanikal" or add a gloss such as "bahan alami (ketapang, dll.)".
"terutama jantan saat musim kawin" implies a season; "during breeding" is better as "saat pemijahan".
"Proses kawin" for "Courtship" is slightly loose; "proses pacaran/pemijahan" fits better.

betta-ideii.name: Betta ideii
notes: Item 2: "memicu munculnya warna dan perilaku memijah" is slightly awkward; consider "memicu warna yang lebih cerah dan perilaku berbiak".

betta-imbellis.name: Cupang Imbellis
notes: Item 3: "Ikan yang dibahas di sini" is looser than "The fish offered here". Use "Ikan yang ditawarkan di sini".
Item 8: "kurang mencolok" for "less ornate" is slightly off. "Kurang berhias" or "lebih sederhana" fits better.

betta-livida.name: Betta livida
notes: Item 4: "1 pasang per sekitar 19 liter (5 galon)" is awkward and keeps gallons; better "1 pasang per 19 liter" (or "per ±19 liter").
Item 1/3: "Betta coccina complex" is left in English; consider "kompleks Betta coccina" or "kelompok Betta coccina" ("complex" is redundant after "kelompok").
Item 7: "perilaku menggigit sirip" is a bit stiff; "sering saling menggigit sirip" is more natural. "Perkirakan akan ada" is also awkward.
Item 6: "Pakannya berupa" is fine, but "cacing darah beku" is better as "cacing sutra/bloodworm beku" (the hobby usually says "bloodworm"). Optional.

betta-mandor.name: Betta mandor
notes: #2: "Pastikan akuarium dan habitatnya sudah siap" adds "akuarium"; source only says habitat. Use "Pastikan habitatnya sudah siap sebelum membeli".
#2: "Di alam, ikan ini sangat rentan" is ambiguous; use "sangat rentan di alam liar" or "sangat rentan terhadap ancaman di alam liar".
#8: "ikan loach Pangio" is redundant; use "loach Pangio" or "ikan Pangio".

#6: "kayu (driftwood)" is vague; use "kayu apung/driftwood" or "kayu rendam", and "botanical" could be "botanical (ranting, biji, dan kulit kayu)" or kept as is, since the term is established in the hobby.
#10: "dierami oleh jantan" is awkward; use "pengeram mulut paternal" or "jantan yang mengerami telur di mulut". "Burayak" for fry is regional; "anakan" is the more common hobby term.
#10: "baby artemia" is mixed; use "naupli artemia yang baru menetas".

betta-miniopinna.name: Betta miniopinna
notes: Item 2: "ventral fins" → "sirip perut" is fine, but "tangkapan alam" is better as "tangkapan liar/hasil tangkapan alam"; minor.
Item 2: "no specific location at this time" rendered as "lokasi pastinya belum diketahui" slightly changes meaning (not specified vs. unknown); use "lokasi spesifik belum disebutkan".
Item 1: "Termasuk kompleks Betta coccina" is fine, but "Tipe pemijahan: pembuat sarang gelembung" is slightly awkward; prefer "Pemijahan: bubble nester (membuat sarang gelembung)".
Item 6: "Cukup agresif" for "Moderately aggressive" is acceptable, but "agresif sedang" is closer; "membangun area pemijahan" is okay.

betta-ocellata.name: Betta ocellata
notes: Item 1: "3+ inches (about 7.6 cm)" rendered as "7,6 cm ke atas" – acceptable, but "N/A" left untranslated; use "tidak tersedia" or "belum dinilai".
Item 5: "kilau biru muda di pipi (bagian operkulum) dan rahang bawah, tubuh, serta ekor" – list structure is awkward; "opercular cheeks" better as "tutup insang (operkulum)".
Item 5: "Jantan dewasa penuh" is stiff; use "jantan dewasa yang sudah tumbuh penuh".
Item 4: "akuarium khusus spesies ini saja" is slightly awkward; use "akuarium khusus satu spesies (species-only tank)".

betta-pallifina.name: Betta pallifina
notes: Item 1: "IUCN Red List: N/A" – "Daftar Merah IUCN: N/A" leaves "N/A" in English; use "T/A" or "Tidak tersedia".
Item 1: "Ukuran maksimal: sekitar 9 cm" – fine, but "Maximum size" is usually "Ukuran maksimum"; minor.
Item 4: "blackworm" – could add "(cacing hitam)"; also "Currently fed on" is better as "Saat ini dapat diberi makan"; minor.
Item 5: "Sebaiknya dipelihara di akuarium khusus satu spesies" – lost "We recommend"; acceptable but could be "Disarankan dipelihara..."; minor.
Item 3: "memicu munculnya warna" – better "memunculkan warna yang lebih cerah/intens"; "perilaku memijah" is okay.
Item 6: "Warna dasar tubuh cokelat" fine; "kilaunya lebih sedikit" could be "kurang berkilau".

betta-patoti.name: Betta patoti
notes: Item 5: "Betina kilau warnanya lebih sedikit" is awkward; use "Kilau pada betina lebih sedikit" or "Betina memiliki kilau yang lebih sedikit".
Item 2: "perilaku kawin" would read better as "perilaku pemijahan", the usual hobby term for breeding.
Item 3: "Diberi pakan hidup, beku, dan kering" reads a little stiffly. "Pakan berupa makanan hidup, beku, dan kering" is more natural.

betta-raja.name: Betta raja
notes: Item 1: "4+ inches (over 10 cm)" is rendered "lebih dari 10 cm"; this is acceptable, but the "4+" nuance is lost. Consider "lebih dari 10 cm" as is. Optional.
Item 3: "aliran sungai kecil" for "streams" is fine, but "berair hitam (blackwater)" is slightly awkward; hobbyists usually write "air hitam (blackwater)" or "perairan blackwater".

Item 5: "much better coloration ... above 78 °F (26 °C)" is rendered "jauh lebih bagus"; "warna lebih cerah" is more natural. "kept in soft water ... but they are more tolerant" is rendered literally and is slightly unclear; consider "umumnya ditemukan di air lunak ber-TDS rendah, tetapi lebih toleran terhadap kondisi air".
Item 8: "kilau warna-warni" for "iridescence" is acceptable, but "iridesen" or "kilau iridesen" is closer. "Cheek plates" is rendered as "pipi (tutup insang)", which is fine.

betta-simorum.name: Betta simorum
notes: Item 3: "Although some sites describe them as fairly peaceful, they have been more on the aggressive side" – "ikan ini cenderung agresif" loses the observed-experience nuance ("have been"); consider "dalam pengamatan cenderung lebih agresif".
Item 3: "watak" is slightly stiff; "temperamen" or "sifat" is more natural for hobbyists.
Item 4: "sirip ekor" alongside "sirip kaudal" is redundant, since caudal means tail fin; the English is also odd, so consider "sirip punggung dan sirip ekor (kaudal)" while keeping meaning.
Item 2: "blackworm" is left in English; consider "cacing hitam (blackworm)" or "cacing sutra/blackworm" as hobbyists use.
Item 1: "Tangkapan alam" is stiff; hobbyists more often say "Tangkapan liar" or "Hasil tangkapan alam".
Item 1: "Pemijahan: pembuat sarang busa" is awkward; use "Pemijahan: membuat sarang gelembung (bubble nest)"; "sarang busa" is acceptable but "sarang gelembung" is the more common hobby term.
Item 6: "hijau berkilau (iridesen)" is fine, but "iridesen" is a stiff loanword; "hijau mengilap" alone suffices.

betta-uberis.name: Betta uberis
notes: Item 1: "Betta coccina complex" is left in English; use "kompleks Betta coccina" or "kelompok Betta coccina" (the current "kelompok ... complex" is redundant).
Item 1: "Pembuat sarang busa" is a clumsy rendering of "bubblenester"; use "Bubblenester (pembuat sarang gelembung)". "Sarang gelembung" is the term hobbyists use, not "sarang busa".
Item 1: "Pemijahan: pembuat sarang busa" is also unclear as a label; "Pemijahan: bubblenester (membuat sarang gelembung)" would read better.
Item 4: "1 pasang per sekitar 19 liter air" drops the "5 gallons" original. Say "1 pasang per 19 liter"; the "air" and "sekitar" wording is awkward.

Item 6: The subject is missing. "The seller currently feeds" became a passive with no agent, so the fact that this is what the seller currently feeds is blurred. Write "Saat ini penjual memberi pakan..." or clarify. "Blackworm" is acceptable, but "cacing hitam (blackworm)" is more natural.

Item 3: "kilau hijau di bagian tengah sisi tubuh" is awkward for "green mid-lateral iridescence"; use "kilau hijau metalik di sepanjang sisi tengah tubuh". "Bertubuh kurang kekar" is also stiff; "bertubuh lebih ramping" is more natural.

betta-unimaculata.name: Cupang unimaculata
notes: Item 3: "lebih menyukai suhu yang lebih sejuk" is redundant; use "menyukai suhu yang lebih sejuk".
Item 3: "memicu munculnya warna" is slightly awkward; "memperkuat warna" or "memunculkan warna" is more natural.
Item 5: "cupang berukuran paling besar" is a bit loose; "termasuk cupang terbesar" is more natural.
Item 8: "pipinya yang berkilau iridesen penuh warna" is awkward and redundant; use "pipi iridesen dengan warna penuh".
Item 1: "Kurang Data" is fine, but "Pemijahan: mouthbrooder" would be more precise as "Pengeraman di mulut" because it describes parental care, not spawning.

boraras-maculatus.name: Rasbora maculatus
notes: "kayu apung (driftwood)" (items 5, 6): "kayu apung" literally means wood that floats. Hobbyists usually say just "driftwood" or "kayu driftwood", or "akar/kayu rendam". Consider dropping "kayu apung".
"botanical (daun dan buah kering)": the gloss adds detail the source doesn't have. Use "botanical" alone or a neutral gloss such as "bahan alami seperti daun dan buah kering".
"Sangat damai": "sangat tenang" or "sangat cinta damai" reads more naturally for fish temperament. This is a minor style point.

boraras-merah.name: Boraras merah
notes: Item 7: "Termasuk predator mikro" is awkward; "Micro-predators" means they eat tiny live prey, so use "Pemangsa mikro" or "Pemakan hewan renik".
Items 6 and 11: "kayu apung (driftwood)" is a misleading term. Use "kayu bakau/akar kayu" or "kayu rendam" for driftwood, since kayu apung means floating wood.
Item 8: "Teman satu akuarium" is clumsy for "Tankmates". Use "Ikan penghuni bersama" or "Teman sekolam".
Item 8: "agresif dan ribut" for "boisterous" is slightly stretched. Use "terlalu aktif/lincah" instead.

brachygobius-doriae.name: Bumblebee goby
notes: Item 11: "goby 'bumblebee'" – word order is slightly unnatural; "goby bumblebee" without quotes, or keep "bumblebee goby", would read more naturally.
Item 10: "dengan cara tertentu" for "somehow" is vague; "dengan cara apa pun" or "perlu diberi pemberat" would be cleaner.

brachygobius-sabanus.name: Bumblebee Goby
notes: "Kalimantan bagian timur laut" (items 1 and 2) for Sabah is geographically wrong. Kalimantan is only the Indonesian part of Borneo, and Sabah is in Malaysia. Use "Pulau Kalimantan (Borneo) bagian timur laut" or "Borneo bagian timur laut".
Item 10: "supaya tidak mengapung" adds a reason that the source doesn't give ("weighed down somehow"). Say only "perlu diberi pemberat".

brachygobius-xanthomelas.name: Bumblebee goby
notes: "Dengan jumlah segitu" is too colloquial for a handbook; use "Dengan jumlah sebanyak itu".
"foto online" could be the more standard "foto di internet" or "foto daring".

brachygobius-xanthozonus.name: Bumblebee goby
notes: "selalu ternyata B. doriae atau B. sabanus" (items 1 and 4) is awkward word order. Use "ternyata selalu B. doriae atau B. sabanus" or "selalu berupa B. doriae atau B. sabanus".
"bumblebee goby" is left in English in items 1 and 4. This is acceptable as a trade name, but you could add an Indonesian gloss such as "ikan gobi lebah" on first mention.
"Max size ... (1.5 in SL)" was dropped in item 1. This is fine, since 38 mm is the metric value.

breitensteinia-cessator.name: Breitensteinia cessator
notes: "punggung adiposa yang rendah dan panjang" for "long low adipose ridge": "punggung" reads as the back, not a ridge. Use "lunas/rigi adiposa" or "lipatan lemak yang rendah dan panjang".
"Belum ada laporan. Tidak ada laporan pemijahan." is repetitive. It is faithful to the source, but could be smoothed to "Belum ada laporan pemijahan."

brevibora-cheeya.name: Brevibora cheeya
notes: Item 4: "about 72 litres" is kept, but the English gives the volume as only a rough figure alongside the dimensions. 80 × 30 cm with no height stated cannot give 72 L. This is a source issue, so mention it only if the translator was meant to flag it.

Item 8: "does not compete well with much larger or more boisterous species" is translated as "lebih agresif" (more aggressive). "Boisterous" means rowdy or lively, not aggressive, so use "lebih lincah/heboh".
Item 11: "Several years prior to its description" is rendered as if the species were the one described. Fine. But "lokasi yang samar" for "vague locality" is awkward; use "lokasi yang tidak jelas".
Item 5: "common beech or oak" is left as "beech atau oak" with no explanation. Add the local context, e.g. "kayu beech (Fagus) atau oak (ek)", or advise on locally available hardwoods.
Item 5: "Cryptocoryne spp. semuanya mampu bertahan" has a broken sentence structure. Change it to "tanaman seperti Microsorum, Taxiphyllum, dan Cryptocoryne spp. semuanya mampu bertahan".
Item 11: "larger head and prepectoral length" is rendered "kepala dan panjang prepektoral lebih besar". Use "kepala lebih panjang dan panjang prepektoral lebih besar".
Item 8: "kalah bersaing dengan spesies" is fine. However, "temannya setangki lainnya dibiarkan" is awkward; use "tidak mengganggu penghuni lain".

camposcia-retusa.name: Kepiting Dekorator
notes: "gelas ukur kecil" for "small beaker": a measuring cylinder is not a beaker. Use "gelas piala (beaker) kecil".
"kolam batu pasang surut" for "rockpools" is awkward. Use "kolam pasang surut (tide pool)" or "genangan batu karang".
"ikut terbawa (hitchhiker) bersama batu atau karang": "bersama batu atau karang" is not in the source. Use "mereka sering ikut terbawa tanpa sengaja (hitchhiker)".
"menggigiti karang lunak" for "nibble" is slightly strong. "mengerat" or "menyobek sedikit" is closer.

carassius-auratus.name: Ikan Koki
notes: Item 9: "Provide a modest amount... Uneaten food indicates overfeeding" fine, but "mengingat kesulitan berenangnya, koki hias sebaiknya diberi pakan dengan kadar protein sedikit lebih tinggi" is OK; however "ganti wadah pakan setiap 6 bulan" is correct. No major issue here.
Item 5: "Crucian carp" is rendered as "ikan mas Crucian (crucian carp)"; use the common name "ikan mas koki liar/ikan crucian" or just "crucian carp" for clarity. Also "komet yang asli" is awkward.
Item 6: "pearlscales" -> "mutiara (pearlscale)" is non-standard; use "pearlscale". "jambul" for wen is non-standard; use "wen (benjolan di kepala)". "sirip anal" is fine.

Item 10: "the temperate nature of the aquatic environment" translated as "lingkungan air yang bersuhu sejuk" is acceptable; but "Zebrafish" heading with "Ikan zebra (zebrafish)" is fine. "Select... ensure equitable access" ok. "cherished companion it is" omitted nuance "teman kesayangan" is OK.
Item 3: translation is left out entirely; the stocklist note is shop talk so omission is allowed.
Item 12: "Goldfish are prolific breeders" -> "mudah berkembang biak" loses 'prolific' (banyak telur); minor. "akuarium pemijahan" fine.
Item 7: "Easy-going" -> "tidak rewel" OK; "open area on the substrate" -> "area terbuka di dasar akuarium" OK.
Item 2: "Tank level: Top, mid-dweller" -> "Area berenang: atas, tengah" acceptable; "Sifat" for Social is vague, use "Perilaku sosial".

carinotetraodon-travancoricus.name: Pea Puffer
notes: Item 12: "kutu air (daphnia)" and "kutu air (moina)" use the same Indonesian name for two different live foods. Use "daphnia" and "moina" (or "kutu air" for daphnia only).
Item 8: "akuarium yang terbuka tanpa tempat berlindung" adds "tanpa tempat berlindung", which is not in the source ("open aquariums"). Say "akuarium dengan tata letak terbuka" or similar.
Item 16: "membingkai bintik-bintik kuning keemasan" for "mark the shining golden yellow spots" is slightly off. Use "menandai" or "menutupi".
Item 3: the source says "Dwarf puffer fish" but the translation says "Pea puffer". Keep the term consistent with the item's own name, or use "ikan buntal kerdil" throughout.
Item 12: "pakannya tetap harus didominasi pakan hewani" is fine, but "Sesekali mereka mungkin mematuk alga" is slightly loose. Use "mengambil" or "memakan sedikit alga dan detritus".

channa-andrao.name: Channa Andrao
notes: "terkenal jago kabur" is too colloquial for a handbook; use "terkenal pandai meloloskan diri".
"ikan pakan hidup seperti ikan beranak": "feeder fish" would read more clearly as "ikan umpan/ikan pakan"; "hidup" is not in the source.
"tidak dapat dicerna dengan baik" for "cannot be properly metabolised": "dimetabolisme" is closer.

channa-asiatica.name: Channa asiatica
notes: Item 8: "Atau, seperti yang umumnya diduga saat ini, merupakan kompleks spesies..." is a sentence fragment. Join it to the previous sentence, e.g. "...banyak varian, atau, seperti yang umumnya diduga saat ini, kompleks spesies...".
Item 8: "peternak" for breeders is slightly off for fish. "pembudidaya" or "breeder" is more usual among hobbyists.
Item 4: "Parameter air tidak berpengaruh" is a bit loose for "irrelevant". "tidak penting" or "tidak menjadi masalah" would be more natural.

channa-aurantimaculata.name: Channa Auranti
notes: Item 4: "tidak segeneralis banyak spesies Channa lain secara ekologis" is stiff. Something like "kurang bersifat generalis secara ekologis dibanding banyak spesies Channa lain" would read more naturally.
Item 8: "Predator sejati" for "obligate predator" is understandable but not the usual term. "Karnivora obligat" or "pemangsa murni" would be clearer.

channa-bleheri.name: Channa Bleheri
notes: Item 8: "jantung sapi atau ayam" could be read as chicken heart; say "daging ayam" or "daging sapi (jantung) atau daging ayam".
Item 10: "saat sedang bertelur" for "gravid" is imprecise; "saat sedang bunting telur" or "saat membawa telur" is better.

Item 12: Several terms are left in English, such as "isthmus", "hypurapophysis", "urostyle", "epibranchial" and "branchial". Add Indonesian forms (e.g. "tulang epibrankial", "pelat gigi brankial") or put them in italics.

channa-stewartii.name: Channa Stewartii
notes: "Selain ikan hidup maupun ikan mati": awkward; better "Selain ikan hidup maupun mati" or "ikan hidup dan ikan mati".", ""mau makan pelet stik": source says "sticks" (food sticks); "pelet stik" is fine but "pelet" is an added specificity, consider "stik pakan".", ""Channa ini" in sentence 1: "This snakehead" is better rendered as "Ikan bandotan/gabus" or "Snakehead ini"; "Channa ini" is slightly vague but acceptable.", ""Karena habitat aslinya tidak berada di wilayah tropis": fine meaning, but "tidak berada di wilayah tropis" could be more natural as "bukan di daerah tropis".", ""pengeram mulut": common hobby term is "mouthbrooder" or "pengeram telur di mulut"; consider "ikan pengerami mulut".

chitala-ornata.name: Clown Knife
notes: Item 7: "ikan mas koki kecil" - 'small goldfish' as feeder; 'ikan mas koki' is redundant/awkward, use "ikan mas koki" or "koki kecil" consistently.
Item 7: "ikan umpan hidup" for 'feeder fish' is loose; prefer "ikan pakan (feeder)".
Items 1/11: "leucistic" left in English; use "leusistik" or add a local term.
Items 1/11: "dikembangkan lewat penangkaran selektif khusus untuk pasar ini" - 'line-bred for the purpose' is slightly over-interpreted; use "dikembangbiakkan secara line-breeding untuk tujuan itu".
Item 11: "populer tanpa alasan yang jelas" - 'inexplicably' fine, but "sirip anal ... menyatu dengan sirip ekor" OK; "Notopterid" could be glossed as "ikan famili Notopteridae".
Item 7: "Predator sejati" for 'obligate predator' is acceptable but "predator obligat" is more precise; sentence "mau menerima ... juga pelet kering" is slightly clumsy.
Item 6: Fahrenheit dropped, which is fine; no issue.
Item 5: "kayu apung (driftwood)" - hobbyists say "kayu driftwood" or "bogwood"; "kayu apung" means floating wood and may mislead.

chromobotia-macracanthus.name: Botia
notes: Item 2: "beberapa sentimeter (sekitar 5 cm ke atas)" understates "a few inches" and adds a specific figure. Use something like "beberapa inci (sekitar 5–8 cm atau lebih)", or just "sekitar 5–8 cm ke atas".
Items 6 and 10: "loach" is left in English in "spesies loach lain" and "Seperti semua loach". Prefer "ikan botia/jenis botia lain", or give it once as "botia (loach)".
Item 6: "ikan lele/catfish" is a clumsy slash. Use "ikan lele (catfish)" or just "ikan catfish".
Item 8: "saat sedang aktif" for "during waking hours" is slightly loose. "pada siang hari" or "saat botia terjaga" is closer.

clarias-batrachus.name: Lele kampung
notes: Items 2 and 12: "leucistic" is left in English. Give an Indonesian term or gloss, for example "leusistik (albino parsial)".
Items 2 and 6: "jago sekali kabur" is too colloquial for a handbook. Use something like "pandai meloloskan diri".
Item 3: "Yang sudah pasti, ikan ini hanya diketahui dari..." is awkward. Use "Hanya diketahui dengan pasti dari daerah aliran sungai di Jawa".
Item 2: "sangat predator" is a little unnatural. Use "sangat bersifat predator" or "pemangsa yang ganas".

corydoras-panda.name: Corydoras panda
notes: "Ikan yang masih setengah dewasa ini": "half-grown" is better rendered as "belum dewasa penuh" or "remaja/berukuran sedang"; "setengah dewasa" sounds slightly awkward.

"belongs to the most popular species" is rendered fine, but "Ini berlaku baik bagi ... maupun bagi para breeder" is a bit stiff; consider "Hal ini berlaku baik untuk ... maupun untuk peternak ikan (breeder)".
"swarm behaviour" -> "perilaku bergerombol" is okay, but "berkelompok/schooling" is more common among Indonesian hobbyists.

corydoras-pygmaeus.name: Corydoras pygmy
notes: Item 7: "Gurami coklat/licorice gourami" is wrong/invented; Parosphromenus is not a 'brown gourami'. Use "licorice gourami (Parosphromenus)" only.
Item 7: "kalah bersaing dengannya saat makan" adds "saat makan" (while feeding), which the source does not say; the original says only outcompete. Remove.
Item 5: "bahan botani (daun kering, ranting, dan sejenisnya)" adds a gloss not in the source; botanicals is a common hobby term, so keep "botanical" without the added list.
Item 3: "Persebarannya luas, tetapi di sebagian wilayah sebarannya rentan" is repetitive; say "Tersebar luas, tetapi rentan terhadap kerusakan habitat di sebagian wilayah sebarannya".
Item 1: "Belum Dievaluasi (Not Evaluated)" is acceptable but the English in brackets is unnecessary.
Item 9: "hasil penangkaran" is fine, but "These ... are captive-bred" (the specific stock being sold) is turned into a general statement; this loses the sense that the fish on offer are captive-bred.
Item 6: "mendukung ... keaktifan ikan" is ok, but "Termasuk pemakan hewan renik" for "Micro-carnivores" is loose; "mikrokarnivora" alone is closer.

corydoras-sterbai.name: Corydoras sterbai
notes: "hasil penangkaran" for "breeding form" is slightly loose; "varian albino hasil budidaya" would be more consistent with "dibudidayakan".
"tangkapan alam" is acceptable, but "hasil tangkapan alam" or "liar (wild-caught)" is more common among hobbyists.

ctenolucius-hujeta.name: Hujeta
notes: Item 2/9: "Ternyata" for "Surprisingly" reads as a discovery, not as a surprise; "Anehnya" or "Mengejutkannya" would be closer.
Item 2/9: "mencari makan di dasar" is fine, but "teman setangkinya" is slightly stiff; "penghuni akuarium lain" is more natural.

cyclocheilichthys-janthochir.name: Keperas
notes: "Spesimen yang ada saat itu berukuran 5–7 cm": source says "currently"; use "saat ini" instead of "saat itu".
"hiduphobiis" not an issue; but "disebut 'shark'" could be "disebut 'shark' (hiu)" or "hiu"-style names such as "sharkminnow"; optional clarification.
"top-model-barb" is fine as a quoted nickname, but "keluarga barb" could be "famili Cyprinidae/barb"; consider "kelompok barb".
"fishhouse" is dropped in sentence 5 ("Spesimen yang ada"); source says specimens at the fishhouse, so restore the location neutrally, e.g. "di tempat penangkaran/toko".
"Ikan ini pernah dijuluki" for "In the fishhouse it got the nickname" omits the fishhouse context; add "di tempat pemeliharaan".
"tidak rewel dalam hal lain" is fine, but "uptight" is better as "tidak banyak menuntut".

cyphotilapia-frontosa.name: Frontosa
notes: "berjenong" / "jenong": the usual hobby term is "nonjol" (Frontosa berjidat nonjol/kepala benjol). "jenong" is a Louhan term and is awkward here. Consider "benjolan di dahi".
"tampak unik" for "look bizarre": "bizarre" means odd or strange. Use "tampak aneh/mencolok" instead.
"Hasil penangkaran enam garis dari Taiwan": this is missing a noun. Write "Ikan hasil penangkaran bergaris enam dari Taiwan".
"banteng" in quotes for "bulls among the cichlids": the idiom is unclear. Consider "tergolong cichlid bertubuh besar dan kekar".
"pengeram mulut (mouthbrooder)": hobbyists usually say "mouthbrooder" or "pengerem mulut". This is fine but not ideal. "Pemijahannya" is also fine.

danio-albolineatus.name: Pearl danio
notes: Item 4: "mau menerima semua jenis pakan" is slightly stiff; "mau makan semua jenis pakan" is more natural.
Item 7: "Burayak" (fry) and "Anakan danio" (young danios) are mixed. Using one term, such as "burayak", would be more consistent.

datnioides-microlepis.name: Indo Datnoid
notes: Item 11: "mungkin sudah punah di Thailand" – "extirpated" means locally extinct; use "punah secara lokal di Thailand" or "hilang dari alam di Thailand".
Item 8: "tertekan" for "intimidated" could be "terintimidasi" or "terdesak" to be closer to the source.

datnioides-pulcher.name: Siamese Tiger Fish
notes: Item 5: "meskipun pola ini juga muncul pada malam hari" is slightly ambiguous. Make clear that this stress-like pattern is also the normal nighttime pattern, e.g. "pola yang sama juga ditampilkan pada malam hari".
Item 11: "famili tripletail laut Lobotidae" leaves "tripletail" in English. Add a local term such as "ikan tripletail (Lobotes)" or a short gloss.

desmopuntius-johorensis.name: Striped Barb
notes: Item 10: "air matang (dari akuarium yang sudah mapan)" – "air matang" means boiled water in Indonesian; use "air dari akuarium yang sudah mapan/matang (cycled)".
Item 11: ordinal inconsistency, "pita pertama" next to "pita ke-2", "ke-3"; use "pita ke-1" or consistent wording.
Item 11: "sungut rostral dan maksila ada" is awkward; use "terdapat sungut rostral dan maksila".
Item 2: "posisinya tampaknya digantikan oleh D. trifasciatus" is awkward; use "tampaknya digantikan oleh D. trifasciatus".

desmopuntius-rhomboocellatus.name: Snakeskin Barb
notes: Item 1: "Pernah tersedia" (once available) slightly shifts "We received"; consider "Kami menerima" neutral e.g. "Telah diterima spesimen tangkapan alam...". Minor.

Item 2: Translation left out. Item 2 is a shop/stocklist note (code 370923, wholesale only); this counts as shop talk the translator may drop, so no fix needed beyond confirming the omission is intentional.

dichotomyctere-nigroviridis.name: Buntal Hijau
notes: Item 8: "lele Arius" – Arius are sea/brackish catfish; consider "ikan manyung (Arius)" or "patin laut/sembilang Arius" for hobbyist clarity.
Item 8: "Terutama ikan jantan, akan terus-menerus berkelahi" is awkward; use "Terutama ikan jantan akan terus-menerus berkelahi" (no comma) or "Pejantan khususnya akan berkelahi terus-menerus".
Item 5: "jadi ganti air sebagian secara rutin itu wajib" is colloquial; use "sehingga penggantian air sebagian secara rutin wajib dilakukan".
Item 8: "agresivitasnya agak terpecah" is slightly unnatural; use "agresi tersebar ke banyak ikan".

epalzeorhynchos-bicolor.name: Red Tail Black Shark
notes: Item 3: "pembangunan manusia" is awkward and can read as human development. Use "pembangunan oleh manusia" or "aktivitas pembangunan".
Item 5: "cukup tidak tahan terhadap penumpukan limbah organik" is clumsy. Use "kurang tahan" or "sensitif terhadap".

Item 7: "pakan kering berkualitas baik berupa pakan serpihan, granul, serta bahan nabati segar" lumps fresh plant material in with dried food. Separate them: dried flakes and granules, plus fresh plant material.
Item 2: "dianggap kritis" is vague for "considered critically endangered". Use "dianggap sangat terancam punah (critically endangered)".

Item 1: "ikan cyprinid" and "Red tail black shark" are acceptable, but the common name is more natural as "red tail black shark" (also "hiu bala/balashark ekor merah"). Use the form hobbyists use consistently.

garra-rufa.name: Ikan Dokter
notes: Item 3: "Lapisan biofilm" for "Growth" adds a term not in the source; the source says algae and the microorganisms in it. Use "Lapisan alga" or "Tumbuhan penempel (alga) beserta mikroorganisme di dalamnya" instead.
Item 4: "batu-batu berlumut alga" is slightly off for "algae-covered stones". "batu yang ditumbuhi alga", as used in item 3, is more consistent.
Item 4: "Terutama ikan-ikan muda sangat rajin" is awkward for "Young fish in particular are very fond of...". Use "Ikan muda khususnya sangat gemar membersihkan dan memakan alga".

Item 5: "Saat dicoba langsung" loses the "self-experiment" meaning, which is the author trying it on their own arm. Use "Dalam percobaan pada diri sendiri", or a neutral wording such as "Dalam uji coba pada lengan sendiri".
Item 5: "dengan sendirinya berenang menghampiri tangan" is fine, but "pemakan alga yang hebat" is a bit colloquial. "pemakan alga yang andal" is more natural.
Item 2: "Ikan dokter" is a common name, but it is not the same as "psoriasis fish". Consider "ikan dokter (ikan psoriasis) Kangal" for clarity.

gnathonemus-petersii.name: Elephant Nose
notes: "saling keroyok, bahkan sampai ada yang mati" – "mob each other, even to death" is slightly softened; better "saling menyerang beramai-ramai, bahkan sampai mati". "keroyok" is colloquial.
"elephant nose" – the usual Indonesian hobby name is "ikan hidung gajah" (or "elephantnose"); consider using it.
"Padahal di alam" – "however" is better rendered as "Namun, di alam"; "padahal" implies contradiction/reproach and is slightly off.
"unik" for "bizarre" – "aneh" or "tidak biasa" is closer to the source.
"kawanan" and "bergerombol" for schools/schooling – "kawanan" is usually for land animals; "gerombolan" is more natural for fish shoals.

gymnarchus-niloticus.name: Aba Aba
notes: #5: "ditanam atau diberi pemberat" adds "ditanam" (planted), which the source doesn't say. Use "diberi pemberat dengan kuat" or "dikunci/ditahan dengan kokoh".
#3: "lahan basah" is a broad term for wetlands in general. For "marshes" use "paya" or "rawa-rawa".

#11: "Karena sirip punggungnya yang memanjang... padahal" in #1 and "pencinta ikan predator monster" in #11 are loose. "Tankbusting" means fish that outgrow and wreck tanks, so "ikan predator raksasa perusak akuarium" is closer.

gymnocorymbus-ternetzi.name: Black Widow
notes: #8: 'manfish' is wrong for 'angel fish'; use 'angelfish' (atau 'ikan manfish' hanya jika dikenal) — better 'angelfish/skalar'.
#4: '20g long' dropped; '(sekitar 70 liter)' fine, but 'standar' ok. Minor: ensure 70 L retained as stated (it is).
#1/#11: 'ikan karasin (Characidae)' – 'karasin' is non-standard for hobbyists; use 'characid' or 'famili Characidae'.
#11: 'cukup 'black tetra'' is awkward for 'simply black tetra'; use 'atau sekadar 'black tetra''.
#11: 'nama dagang' for 'common names' should be 'nama umum'.
#5: 'Cukup tidak rewel soal dekorasi' is awkward; use 'Tidak terlalu rewel soal dekorasi'.
#7: 'pelet butiran' adds 'pelet'; source says granules – use 'granul'. 'kutu air' for Daphnia is ok, but 'Daphnia' commonly used.
#10: 'java moss' and 'spawning mop (media pemijahan dari benang)' adds explanation; acceptable but 'lumut jawa' is the local term.
#10: 'Dengan jumlah sebanyak itu' fine; 'indukan harus segera dipindahkan' ok. 'burayak' is acceptable but 'anakan' is more common among hobbyists.
#3: 'kali' redundant with 'anak sungai'; 'creeks' ok but streamline.

gyrinocheilus-aymonieri.name: Chinese Algae Eater
notes: Item 1: "Umurnya bisa lebih dari 15 tahun, dan sebagian besar tidak cocok untuk akuarium komunitas" – the subject is ambiguous; better "ikan ini sebagian besar tidak cocok untuk..." or "kurang cocok untuk...".
Item 3: "kerikil kecil, kerikil" for "pebbles, gravel" is a little repetitive; consider "kerikil besar/koral, kerikil".

helostoma-temminckii.name: Tambakan
notes: Item 1: 'Tambakan atau kissing gourami' — adds a local name that is not in the source; also 'famili Helostomatidae' is added. 'Tambakan' is the established local name, but the added family name is not in this sentence.
Item 1: 'Bentuk putih kemerahan' for 'pinkish-white' is okay, but item 11 then says 'Bentuk pink' — use one term consistently.
Item 8: 'ikan lele/catfish' — the source says 'catfishes' (a broad group), and 'lele' is a specific catfish; use 'ikan berkumis/catfish' or just 'catfish'.

Item 5: 'Pencahayaan relatif tidak penting ... lumut/alga jangan dibasmi' — acceptable, but 'mengambil udara dari permukaan' is fine. 'saluran keluar' for 'outflows' is slightly clumsy. 'merumput biofilm' is odd; use 'memakan/menggerus biofilm'.
Item 7: 'Bibirnya yang tebal' — the source says 'fleshy lips'; 'berdaging' is closer. 'mengecap' for 'mouthing' is unnatural; use 'membuka-tutup mulut'.
Item 7: 'Tubifex' translated as 'cacing sutra' — fine, but 'Tapis insang' / 'lengkung insang' are not clearly rendered as 'gill rakers' and 'gill arches' to hobbyists.

hemigrammus-erythrozonus.name: Glowlight Tetra
notes: "sejauh ini hanya diketahui" (items 1 and 2) adds a hedge the English doesn't have. Use "hanya diketahui dari".
"manfish" for angel fish is acceptable. "angelfish" is the more common hobby spelling and could be added in brackets.
"ternakan massal" and "hasil ternakan" read slightly stiff. "hasil penangkaran massal" is more natural.

hemirhamphodon-pogonognathus.name: Julung-julung
notes: Item 5: "teman setanknya tidak boleh terlalu kasar" – "setank" is non-standard; use "penghuni akuarium lain" or "ikan lain dalam akuarium yang sama". "robust" is better rendered "terlalu bongsor/agresif/aktif" than "kasar".
Item 5: "Sesama jantan bisa cukup sering berkelahi" adds "sering" (frequency); the source says quite quarrelsome, so use "cukup suka berkelahi".

Item 2: "tidak tahan pengiriman" is stiff; use "tidak tahan terhadap pengangkutan/transportasi". "kondisi ... hampir tidak mendukung kehidupan" is fine but "miskin" for food supply could be "minim nutrisi".
Item 2: "aklimatisasi" is good, but "Terutama, ikan ini..." is awkward; use "Ikan ini terutama tidak tahan...".
Item 4: "dimakan dengan lahap" slightly strengthens "with pleasure"; "dimakan dengan senang hati/mau memakan" would be closer.

hemisilurus-moolenburghi.name: Lais
notes: Item 1: "Data Deficient/Kekurangan Data" – use the standard Indonesian form "Kekurangan Data (Data Deficient)"; slash format is awkward.
Item 1: "orang yang mengoleksi ikan ini" – better "yang mengoleksi spesimen ikan ini" / "kolektornya".
Item 1: "Ukuran maksimum: 500 mm SL" – 500 mm could be given as 50 cm for hobbyist readability; "SL" explained is fine.
Item 4: "juluran berbulu seperti bulu ayam" adds "seperti bulu ayam" (like chicken feathers), which is not in the source; use "juluran berbulu halus" (feathery extensions).
Item 4: "punya" is colloquial in a handbook; prefer "memiliki". "tutup insang" is fine for opercle.
Item 5: Redundant repetition "belum dilaporkan. Belum ada laporan pemijahan" mirrors the source; could be merged, minor.

heros-severus.name: Severum
notes: "agak sadah" for "medium hard": use "sadah sedang" (or "kesadahan sedang"); "agak sadah" slightly shifts the meaning.
"Hal ini terutama karena perilaku berkembang biaknya": "berkembang biak" is awkward. Use "perilaku pemijahannya" or "cara berbiaknya".
"mengerami telur di mulut (mouthbreeding)": hobbyists usually say "mouthbrooder" or "pengeram mulut". Also, "bertelur di substrat" is vague; "memijah di substrat (substrate breeder)" is better.
"Amazon, Orinoco": add "Sungai" or "DAS" (e.g., "Sungai Amazon, Sungai Orinoco") so the reader knows these are river systems.
"warnanya mungkin jadi memudar": "jadi" is colloquial; use "menjadi" in the formal handbook register.
"Ikan juga bisa lebih rentan" and "tanda-tanda kondisi yang menurun": stiff and vague. Use "tanda-tanda penurunan kondisi" or "kesehatannya menurun".
"Pakan nabati perlu ditambahkan": the source says "vegetarian components". "Komponen nabati" or "pakan berbahan nabati" is closer. "pelet stik" for "sticks" is fine, but "stik" alone is enough.

hyphessobrycon-herbertaxelrodi.name: Black Neon Tetra
notes: Item 5: "ditanami tanaman air dengan rimbun" is awkward and redundant. Use "ditanami rimbun" or "penuh tanaman air".
Item 8: "direncanakan dengan baik" is a loose rendering of "well-researched". Something like "yang dirancang dengan matang" is more precise.
Item 11: "garis tengah lateral" is a stiff rendering of "midlateral stripe". Use "garis tengah badan" or "garis lateral tengah".

hyphessobrycon-megalopterus.name: Black phantom tetra
notes: Item 3: "kutu air (Daphnia, Moina)" is wrong in meaning for a hobby handbook; Daphnia is usually "kutu air" but Moina is "kutu air" too, so this is acceptable. Better to keep Daphnia and Moina as in the source without the generic gloss.
Item 1/11: "Sebagian besar catatannya" and "dibudidayakan" are fine. Better to use "tulang postorbital" and "bintik humeral" with the usual "bintik bahu" gloss for readability.

Item 2: "anak sungai utama rio Mamoré" for "main affluent" is fine. "yang mengalirkan air dari lahan basah" reverses the sense: the Guaporé drains the Pantanal wetland, so "yang menguras/mengalirkan air lahan basah tropis" would be clearer.

Item 8: "well-researched community aquarium" became "penghuninya sudah dipilih dengan cermat". This slightly changes the meaning. A closer rendering is "akuarium komunitas yang direncanakan dengan matang".
Item 10: "Karena itu, perilakunya lebih menarik dan warnanya lebih bagus" is fine. "Alas plastik model 'rumput'" is a bit vague, so write "matras plastik tipe 'rumput'".

kryptopterus-cryptopterus.name: Ikan lais
notes: Item 1: "Size: 200 mm (7.9 in) SL" -> "20 cm SL" is correct, but "Lokasi tipe: ... Kalimantan Selatan, Kalimantan" is fine; main issue is elsewhere.
Item 3: temperature range "22.0-27.0°C (71.6-80.6°F)" lost the Fahrenheit original; acceptable, but 22–27 °C is fine, so no change needed.
Item 5: "Mau langsung menyantap" is awkward and slightly changes meaning of 'readily feeds'; use "Mudah menerima pakan hidup/beku dan pakan buatan lain seperti pelet".
Item 9: added explanation "(sangat kecil/tidak berkembang)" is not in the source; remove the added gloss or keep just "rudimenter".
Item 6: "kelompok minimal tiga ekor" is fine, but "lele Asia" for catfishes and "Teman satu akuarium" are okay; no change needed.

kryptopterus-vitreolus.name: Lele kaca
notes: "karena arah cahaya dan gerakan ikan harus pas betul" – the source says "the interaction of light and movement of the fish must fit exactly"; consider "interaksi cahaya dan gerakan ikan harus pas" to stay closer to the original.

"seorang penghobi bergelar sarjana biologi" – the source says "a keeper with a degree in biology"; fine in meaning, but "pemelihara" or "aquascaper" is not needed. Keep "penghobi" and consider "lulusan biologi" as more natural.
"Dari kebiasaan ini" – the source says "In this context"; "Dalam kegiatan ini" would be more faithful, since it was not a habit that led to the discovery.

labidochromis-caeruleus.name: Labidochromis caeruleus
notes: Item 11: "cichlid Danau Rift" reads as if the lake is called Rift. Use "cichlid danau-danau Rift Valley" or "cichlid Great Rift Lakes".
Item 10: "memuntahkan telur/burayak" mixes two terms. Use "memuntahkan telur atau burayak".
Item 7: "mau menerima sebagian besar pakan" is slightly stiff. Use "mau memakan sebagian besar jenis pakan".

macropodus-opercularis.name: Ikan Paradise
notes: Item 12: "cacing sutra" for "blackworms" is inexact. Cacing sutra is usually Tubifex, and blackworms are Lumbriculus. Use "blackworm" or "cacing hitam".
Item 8: "kayu apung" for "Driftwood" can be read as wood that floats. Use "kayu driftwood" or "kayu rendaman".
Item 14: "urutan hierarki" is redundant for "pecking order". Use "hierarki dominansi" or "urutan dominansi".
Item 2: "LC (Risiko Rendah)" would be better as "Berisiko Rendah", the usual Indonesian wording for Least Concern.

maylandia-estherae.name: Red Zebra
notes: Item 10: "Care must be taken, if you decide to move the fish... harassment by the males" is rendered as "memindahkan betina... betina tidak diganggu jantan", which narrows the meaning. The source says the fish in general, not only the female.

Item 10: "dissipate this aggression" became "menyebarkan agresi". That is fine, but the sentence "Jantan cukup agresif saat mengejar betina" slightly changes the nuance of "quite vigorous in his pursuits".
Item 10: "Maternal mouthbrooder" became "pengeram mulut induk betina". This is awkward; use "pengeram mulut (mouthbrooder) oleh induk betina".

Item 10: "Some breeders artificially strip the fry... at the 2 week stage" became "mengeluarkan burayak secara paksa". "Secara paksa" is too harsh for an artificial method; use "secara manual/buatan".
Item 11: "Mbuna yang memang pantas populer" is stiff. Use "Mbuna yang populer dan memang layak".

Item 11: "jantan oranye dan OB" (item 1) says "orange and OB males occur", but "yellow or OB females" is missing from item 1. That is acceptable as a summary, but the item 11 and item 1 colour descriptions are inconsistent.
Item 8: "The tank should be overcrowded" was rendered with the English term "(overcrowded)" in brackets. "Padat tebar" would be the more natural hobby term.
Item 8: "peace loving species" became "spesies yang damai". The wording is fine, but "Peacock atau Utaka" should be clarified as cichlid groups.
Item 3: "karang-karang batu" is awkward for "reefs" in a freshwater lake. Use "area bebatuan/terumbu batu".
Item 1: "bisa kawin silang (hibrida)" is a clumsy use of the noun "hibrida". Use "bisa berhibridisasi".

mikrogeophagus-ramirezi.name: Ramirezi
notes: Item 8: "sekitar 60 cm" for "a couple of feet across" is acceptable, but "lebar" is odd; use "berdiameter sekitar 60 cm".
Item 9: "kemerahmudaan" is non-standard and awkward; use "bercak merah muda".
Item 5: "siklus nitrogennya belum matang" is fine, but "biologically immature" is more commonly "belum matang secara biologis / belum cycling"; consider adding "(cycling)".
Item 5: "tidak satu pun berasal dari Amerika Selatan" is correct; "ganti air dalam jumlah sangat besar sebaiknya dihindari" reads clumsy, use "hindari pergantian air dalam volume sangat besar".
Item 10: "memakan telur atau anaknya" adds "or fry" (source says brood, so acceptable), but "mikroworm" should be "cacing mikro (microworm)".
Item 7: "kutu air" for Daphnia is acceptable, but "Daphnia" is the usual hobby term; "kerang-kerangan" for shellfish is vague (could include crustaceans), use "kerang dan udang-udangan/seafood".
Item 11: "klad" is unusual for hobbyists; use "klade". "Kullander (1998) memakai Mikrogeophagus ... sedangkan Microgeophagus sensu Frey ..." slightly alters the sentence flow but meaning kept.
Item 1: "Ram atau ramirezi" adds a name not in the source ("The ram"); acceptable but could be "Ram" only.

myxocyprinus-asiaticus.name: Chinese Hi-Fin Banded Shark
notes: "Semua ikan yang diperdagangkan berasal dari budi daya dan merupakan hasil penangkaran" is redundant; budi daya and penangkaran say the same thing. Use one, e.g. "berasal dari hasil penangkaran/budi daya".
"mighty dorsal fin" became "sirip punggung besar", which loses the sense of a strong or imposing fin. Consider "sirip punggung yang megah/kokoh".
"semua ikan ini yang beredar di perdagangan" is awkward word order. Use "semua ikan jenis ini yang beredar di perdagangan" or similar.
"Chinese Whimple Carp" and "Batman-Loach" are left in English with no local name or explanation. Consider adding a note that this is a trade name, or italicise it.
"tahan menghadapi musim dingin" is clumsy. Use "tahan musim dingin" or "dapat bertahan di musim dingin di Eropa Tengah".

"Myxocyprinus" is the genus name, but the ID text does not give the full species name. This is fine if the source also omits it. Check that the genus is not mixed up with the common name "Chinese Whimple Carp".

oryzias-latipes.name: Medaka
notes: Item 8: "Sebagian besar tidak agresif terhadap Oryzias lain" is ambiguous. Say clearly whether it means the same species or other Oryzias species.
Item 11: "ikan gigi (toothcarp)" is not a common hobby term. Use "ikan gigi" with the Cyprinodontiformes context, or keep "toothcarp" alone.
Item 5: "Paling baik dipelihara di akuarium yang penuh tanaman air" is slightly stronger than "heavily planted". "Akuarium dengan banyak tanaman" would be more natural.

osphronemus-goramy.name: Gurami
notes: Item 1: 'Gurami, Osphronemus goramy' - 'giant gourami' translated as just 'Gurami'; use 'Gurami raksasa' or 'Gurame' to keep 'giant' (same in item 1 first sentence 'gurami berukuran besar').
Item 4: '72" x 24" x 24"' = 183 × 61 × 61 cm is correct, but 'Volume: ~681 liter' fine; no issue otherwise. Consider noting minimum tank depth/height explicitly.
Item 5: 'luar biasa jorok' is awkward/colloquial for 'exceptionally messy'; use 'sangat banyak menghasilkan kotoran'.
Item 5: 'Tanaman apung sebaiknya ada' is vague; the source says floating plants are preferable (as cover) - use 'Tanaman apung lebih disarankan'.
Item 8: 'ikan sapu-sapu (loricariid)' fine, but 'lele besar' for 'large catfish' acceptable; 'teman setangki' is non-standard, use 'ikan penghuni lain'.

Item 10: 'Pemijahan terjadi di sekitar sarang' fine, but 'burayak' for fry is OK; 'matang kelamin' acceptable. Item 10: 'Jantan membangun sarang ... (di alam termasuk rumput dan akar)' garbles 'including grasses and roots in nature'; use 'termasuk rumput dan akar di alam'.
Item 11: 'sangat membuat ikan stres' is awkward; use 'sangat membuat ikan stres' -> 'menyebabkan stres berat pada ikan'.

Item 11: 'Gurami sering dijual' - original says 'They' (O. goramy); also 'finnage' rendered as 'siripnya yang merah' loses 'red finnage' nuance slightly (fine). Item 11: 'dying' mistranslation check: 'varian yang diwarnai' correct but 'we strongly advise' became passive 'sangat disarankan' OK.

osteoglossum-bicirrhosum.name: Arwana Silver
notes: Item 8: "buah yang jatuh ke air" adds "ke air", which isn't in the source ("fallen nuts and fruits"). Use "buah dan biji-bijian yang berjatuhan".
Item 8: "kacang-kacangan" for "nuts" is slightly off for forest fruit; "biji-bijian" or "buah berkulit keras" fits better.
Item 10/2: "anakan" and "burayak" are mixed for fry/juveniles. Use "burayak" for fry and "anakan" for juveniles consistently.
Item 11: "sirip dubur" is correct but hobbyists more often write "sirip anal".

pangasianodon-hypophthalmus.name: Patin siam
notes: Item 10: "di peternakan ikan di Asia Timur dan Tenggara" adds "dan Tenggara", which the source ("Far Eastern fish farms") doesn't say. Use "Asia Timur", or a neutral "di Asia". Also prefer "tambak/kolam budidaya ikan" over "peternakan ikan".

Item 10: "akhir musim semi dan musim panas" is a literal rendering of the seasons. Indonesian readers may find it unnatural, since the Mekong's seasons are better described as the end of the dry season and the start of the rainy season. Consider a note or a neutral rewording.
Item 11: "sekitar satu meter" turns "a few feet" into one figure. "Beberapa kaki" is roughly 0.9–1.5 m, so "sekitar 1 meter atau lebih" is safer.

paracheirodon-axelrodi.name: Cardinal Tetra
notes: Item 10: 'pindahkan keduanya ke akuarium pemijahan pada sore atau malam hari' – source says only 'in the evening'; remove added 'atau malam hari'/'sore'.
Item 10: 'Jika setelah beberapa hari belum ada telur, pindahkan pasangan tersebut' – the source says 'after a couple of days'; 'beberapa hari' is OK but better 'dua hari'.
Item 10: 'GH 1–5' lacks unit; use '1–5 dGH' for consistency with the earlier specification.
Item 3: 'Saat hujan musim penghujan mulai turun' is redundant; use 'Saat musim hujan mulai'.
Item 3: 'sungai-sungai kecil di hutan dan anak sungai kecil' is repetitive; use 'sungai kecil dan anak sungai di hutan'.
Item 3: 'vegetasi tepian yang lebat sebagai tempat ikan berlindung' – 'dense' was applied to riparian vegetation, but in the source it modifies the growth of plants and vegetation; minor.
Item 3: 'vegetasi tepian ... sering menjorok ke atas air' – use 'menjuntai di atas air'.
Item 1/11: 'cukup banyak ikan' understates 'a significant proportion'; use 'sebagian besar/sebagian signifikan'.
Item 5: 'Buah alder (alder cone)' – alder cones are 'kerucut alder' / 'kerucut pohon alder'; 'buah' is imprecise.
Item 8: 'akuarium komunitas yang komposisinya sudah dipertimbangkan dengan baik' – 'well-researched' meaning is loosely rendered; consider 'yang direncanakan dengan matang'.

pelvicachromis-pulcher.name: Kribensis
notes: Item 8: "sangat agresif" for "very vigorous" shifts meaning; use "sangat aktif/lincah" (or "aktif dan agresif").
Item 8: "characin kecil (seperti tetra)" adds a gloss not in the source; remove it or just keep "characin kecil".
Item 7: "Mau menerima hampir semua jenis pakan" is stiff; use "Menerima hampir semua jenis pakan" or "Mau makan hampir semua jenis pakan".

phenacogrammus-interruptus.name: Congo Tetra
notes: Item 17: "sirip yang lebih megah" and "sirip megah" for "elaborate fins" is slightly odd. Use "sirip yang lebih panjang dan rumit" or "sirip yang lebih indah".
Item 4: "Galur ini stabil secara turun-temurun" for "breed true" reads stiffly. Something like "sifat warnanya menurun dengan baik pada keturunannya" would be more natural.

phractocephalus-hemioliopterus.name: Red Tail Catfish
notes: "ikan lancefish": English name left untranslated; use "ikan sandeel/lancefish (Ammodytes)" with a short gloss, or a local equivalent.
"batu koral besar yang halus": "koral" suggests coral. Use "kerikil/kerakal besar yang halus" or "batu sungai besar yang halus".
"ikan monster" for "tankbusters": unclear. Use "ikan raksasa/ikan besar yang biasa dipelihara (tankbuster)".
"sampai mereka menolak menerima lagi": "mereka" is ambiguous. Say "sampai akuarium publik menolak menerima lagi".

poecilia-latipinna.name: Molly Sailfin
notes: Item 1/4: "125 mm SL" kept in mm; fine, but "Max size" bracketed 5 in dropped is okay. No issue.
Item 5: "cukup sadah atau lebih sadah" is awkward; use "berkesadahan sedang hingga tinggi".
Item 5: "mineral \"sadah\"" is awkward; use "mineral penyebab kesadahan" for the "hard" minerals.
Item 5: "gerakan bergoyang-goyang di tempat (shimmying)" is fine, but "sirip yang menguncup" is better as "sirip menguncup/mengatup" - minor.
Item 7: "Di alam, ikan ini hampir sepenuhnya herbivor" okay; "pakan serpihan sayuran" fine. "menunya" is slightly colloquial.
Item 8: "Teman setangki" is non-standard; use "penghuni akuarium lain / tank mate". "catfish" is acceptable, though "ikan lele-lelean" is less common.
Item 10: "Masa bunting" is used for mammals; use "masa kehamilan/masa mengandung" or "induk bunting" is common among hobbyists, so minor. "burayak" and "anakan" are mixed; keep consistent ("anakan").
Item 10: "hingga 50 anak" okay; "kemungkinannya memakan anaknya sendiri" ok. "tipe liar ... bentuk domestik" is fine.
Item 3: "yang banyak vegetasinya" modifies awkwardly; use "yang banyak ditumbuhi vegetasi".
Item 2: "mapan" for "established" is unusual; use "telah berkembang biak dan menetap".

poecilia-sphenops.name: Molly
notes: Item 1/10: "tidak sadah dan tidak basa" is awkward; use "tidak sadah dan tidak beralkali (pH rendah)", e.g. "air tawar yang lunak dan cenderung asam"; "not hard and alkaline" means soft/acidic water.
Item 4: "wajib dipelihara" is too strong for "must be maintained"; "harus" would be more natural.
Item 4: "sirip menguncup" is fine, but "clamped fins" is usually "sirip mengatup/menguncup"; keep it consistent.
Item 4: "mineral 'kesadahan'" is slightly awkward; use "mineral penyebab kesadahan".
Item 3: "Alas akuarium" is unusual; use "Ukuran dasar akuarium" or "Dimensi alas".
Item 3: The final "90 × 30 × 30 cm" is left bare; clarify it as the tank dimensions.
Item 9: "dipijahkan" is imprecise for livebearers; use "dikembangbiakkan".
Item 9: "kotak beranak" for breeding traps is fine, but "jaring" should read "jaring pembesaran".
Item 10: "menjalankan siklus akuarium laut" is awkward; use "mematangkan (cycling) akuarium laut baru".
Item 10: "cacat" for "malformed" is fine, but "bentuk tubuhnya tidak normal" is more neutral.

polypterus-senegalus.name: Polypterus Senegal
notes: Item 11: "melengkungkan sirip anal dan sirip ekornya di sekitar alat kelamin betina" – 'cupping' is better rendered as 'membentuk cekungan/mengapit' with the fins; 'melengkungkan' is slightly off.
Item 12: "kelompok polypterid 'rahang atas'" – 'tribe' is rendered vaguely; consider 'suku/kelompok berahang atas'.
Item 9: "Tidak bisa dipercaya bersama teman setangki yang muat di mulutnya" is awkward; better 'Tidak boleh dicampur dengan ikan yang muat di mulutnya'.
Item 12: "Seperti spesies Anabantoid" – use the common term 'ikan labirin (anabantoid)'.
Item 2/12: 'Senegal bichir' left untranslated, fine, but 'cichlid' in item 8 could be 'pelet untuk cichlid'; minor.
Item 12: 'meridionalis ... Perlu dicatat' fine; 'indra penciumannya yang sangat tajam' ok.
